law: Before running the sample code project in Xcode, select the sample target, then configure it to use your Developer team for signing.

Because the contact store methods are synchronous, it’s best practice to use them on background threads.

Each operation requires a specific set of contact keys to correctly perform the operation.
Note that the user receives a prompt only the first time an app requests access; all subsequent calls use the existing permissions.
To avoid having your app’s UI main thread block for this access, you can use either the asynchronous method or dispatch your usage to a background thread.
You can either use to check the availability of a single contact key, or to check multiple keys.
When refetching a unified contact, be sure to use its identifier.
